payload.gloss: the design is the fixed target while a plan realizes it. A change never moves a shard that a running plan is building against: a change bearing on such a shard is held as a note until that plan completes, then enters the design and is realized by a following plan; a change to any other part of the design enters at once; sequenced after the work it depends on, so every plan finishes against the goal it began with. Only when a running plan is found to be built on a shard that is itself wrong does the plan stop; the design is corrected once, and the planner rectifies or rebuilds the plan before work resumes.
